method: Manual inspection at fixed output pixel scale using full helmet horizontal span and outer lens long-axis landmarks. Approximate estimates, not threshold component measurements.
interpretation: Comparable helmet scale is preserved in these samples; lens projection differs with tilt. All pose contacts were visually compared at fixed scale, but these measurements do not certify exact rigid proportions or every frame.
rejectedMeasurement: Automatic warm-color largest-component fragmented the helmet and dark component joined outline/cape, so rejected-marker-segmentation.json is NOT a scale acceptance result.
